description: Discover user tables/views and column types available to a dedicated PostgreSQL data-reader role. Requires a separate source configured with accessMode=data_read; ordinary diagnostic sources cannot read business data. Permissions are discovered dynamically, with no predefined table list. Default 20 tables per page, maximum 100 or a stricter source limit. Continue using sampling.nextOffset. Results follow PostgreSQL grants; RLS and view-owner permissions apply.
name: inspect_database_schema
